description: Source code implementing singleton pattern and methods for managing constant tensor values, shapes, and related metadata within the torch::jit namespace, specifically for ONNX constant map handling.

classes.name: ConstantValueMap
classes.description: Singleton class managing mappings of tensor names to ranks, shapes, values, and metadata for ONNX constant propagation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConstantValueMap.

methods.name: SetRank
methods.description: Sets the rank for a tensor by name.

methods.name: HasRank
methods.description: Checks if a rank is set for a tensor.

methods.name: GetRank
methods.description: Retrieves the rank of a tensor if set.

methods.name: SetAllGraphInputsStatic
methods.description: Marks all graph inputs as static or not.

methods.name: GetAllGraphInputsStatic
methods.description: Gets whether all graph inputs are marked static.

methods.name: SetAllGraphInputsReliableComputed
methods.description: Marks all graph inputs as reliably computed.

methods.name: GetAllGraphInputsReliableComputed
methods.description: Checks if all graph inputs are marked reliable.

methods.name: SetShape
methods.description: Sets the shape for a tensor by name.

methods.name: HasShape
methods.description: Checks if a shape is set for a tensor.

methods.name: GetShape
methods.description: Retrieves the shape of a tensor if set.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the tensor value by name.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.description: Checks if a tensor value is set.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the tensor value if set.

methods.name: EraseValue
methods.description: Removes the tensor value by name.

methods.name: GetCompleteShapeInto1DInt64Vector
methods.description: Converts a complete symbolic shape into a 1D vector of int64.

methods.name: GetShapeInto1DInt64Vector
methods.description: Gets shape as a 1D vector of int64 if shape is complete.

methods.name: GetShapeInto1DInt64VectorWithOneUnknown
methods.description: Gets shape as a 1D vector with one unknown dimension marked as -1.

methods.name: GetValueInto1DInt64Vector
methods.description: Converts tensor value to a 1D vector of int64.

methods.name: SetTypeReliable
methods.description: Sets whether tensor type is reliable.

methods.name: HasTypeReliable
methods.description: Checks if tensor type reliability is set.

methods.name: GetTypeReliable
methods.description: Gets whether tensor type is reliable.

methods.name: SetUseInferredType
methods.description: Sets whether to use inferred type for a tensor.

methods.name: HasUseInferredType
methods.description: Checks if inferred type usage is set for a tensor.

methods.name: GetUseInferredType
methods.description: Gets whether inferred type is used for a tensor.

methods.name: SetShapeValue
methods.description: Sets symbolic shape value for a tensor.

methods.name: HasShapeValue
methods.description: Checks if symbolic shape value is set.

methods.name: GetShapeValue
methods.description: Retrieves symbolic shape value.

methods.name: GetInferredShapeData
methods.description: Returns shape data obtained by ONNX data propagation.

methods.name: GetSymbolDimMap
methods.description: Returns map of symbol dimensions.

methods.name: GetDimSymbolMap
methods.description: Returns map of dimension symbols.

methods.name: UpdateValueName
methods.description: Updates tensor name across all maps.

methods.name: ClearMaps
methods.description: Clears all internal maps and resets static flags.

methods.name: PrintMaps
methods.description: Prints internal maps for debugging.
